page.overview:
Who is Sergio Altieri?

is the titular protagonist of Sergio's Lucky Day, the second story of Fazbear Frights 8: Gumdrop Angel. He is a highly insecure man who wants nothing more than to be impressive, but never feels satisfied whenever he climbs the ladder at work. After a terrible string of bad luck, Sergio comes across a unique toy and his luck begins to change.

Sergio is five foot seven with a long and somewhat pointed nose, big ears, small and beady eyes, and thick lips. He used to be compact, slender, muscular and sleek, but once he became project manager he gains a growing potbelly. Sergio wears his black hair slicked back, and always dresses in dark, fitted clothing. He doesn’t consider himself good-looking, but he tries to have his own impressive style.

Sergio is an architectural phenom that excels at math and has an eye for spatial relationships, knowing how to mold something eye-catching. This talent helps him reach his biggest dream, which is to be impressive. Sergio is highly determined to reach his ideals and works hard to get what he wants, although he lacks foresight and never feels satisfied upon reaching his next step. He also wants freedom to do whatever he wants and becomes frustrated by the safe, limited changes he’s tasked with. Sergio can’t read people and is unsure of what others around him feel or think. He also finds being friendly difficult and prefers staying at home with takeout rather than attending social events, even if he enjoys showing off his dance moves. Sergio is very selfish and craves validation, wanting a girlfriend who dotes on him and shares his interests, like sci-fi. He even lies his way through his first steady relationship purely because a steady girlfriend made him feel impressive.

After finding Lucky Boy, Sergio becomes very delusional and senses negative undertones in others when none are present. He also becomes highly possessive and dependent on Lucky Boy.
